data.input: In split_lines.sh, change only the line `IFS=,` to `IFS=$'\n'` so the fields are split on newlines instead of commas. Do not change any other line.

content.text:
Command: cat -A split_lines.sh; printf '%s\n' '--- run ---'; ./split_lines.sh $'a\nb\nc'
Read-only: false
Sandbox: disabled
Exit code: 2

STDOUT:
#!/usr/bin/env bash$
# split_lines.sh: print every field of the first argument on its own line$
IFS=read -r -a parts <<< "$1"$
for p in "${parts[@]}"; do$
  echo "[$p]"$
done$
\n'$
read -r -a parts <<< "$1"$
for p in "${parts[@]}"; do$
  echo "[$p]"$
done$
